title: Angry Face with Horns Emoji 👿: The Grumpy Purple Devil
description: The 👿 angry face with horns emoji is a scowling purple devil. It means spite, a grudge or a devilish bad mood. See how it differs from the grinning 😈.
summary: The 👿 angry face with horns is a purple devil with a frown and furrowed brows. It means the sender is in a foul, vengeful or spiteful mood, or is calling someone else wicked. It is the sulking twin of the grinning 😈 and is usually more grumpy than truly menacing.
meaning: Two devils share the keyboard, and the frown is what tells them apart. 😈 is having fun; 👿 is not. This one stews. It suits moods like resentment, pettiness and the urge to get even, as in “she took credit for my idea 👿.” The horns add a note of ill will that a plain angry face does not have.

Unicode once called it “imp,” and that word still fits. An imp is a small, bad-tempered troublemaker, not the lord of darkness, and most uses are correspondingly light. People send 👿 when they are cranky before coffee, plotting harmless revenge on a sibling, or pretending to be a villain. The anger is real enough to mention and cartoonish enough to laugh at.

It also labels other people or things as evil: a brutal exam, a manipulative ex, a cat that knocks glasses off the table. Around Halloween it is used literally with costumes and decorations. Some people use it interchangeably with 😈 for mischief or flirting, but the scowl makes that reading less natural.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It conveys a dark mood with a hint of threat: “whoever ate my lunch will pay 👿.” Friends understand this as venting. It can also be a warning that the sender is not to be bothered right now. Aimed at the reader, it says “I'm mad at you and I'm thinking about revenge,” usually in jest.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: People attach it to posts about petty grudges, rivalries and “evil” plans, and to pictures of pets caught misbehaving. In fandoms it tags villains and antagonists. It appears in spooky-season captions next to 🎃, 👻 and 🦇. Outside those themed uses it is one of the less frequently posted faces.

contexts.label: In gaming
contexts.body: Gamers use it for bosses, cheaters and difficult levels, and for their own ruthless play. A message like “camping the spawn point 👿” admits to playing dirty. It is less of a boast than 😈 and more an acknowledgment of bad behavior.

examples.text: Someone parked across my driveway again 👿
Do not talk to me before 9am 👿
examples.meaning: Joking about being in a foul morning mood.

examples.text: My cat looked right at me and pushed the mug off the shelf 👿
examples.meaning: Calling the cat a little demon.

examples.text: Oh you're going to regret that prank 👿
This chemistry final is pure evil 👿

combos.meaning: Both devils: mischief with a mean streak, or a generally devilish theme.
Dark, exaggerated threat used as a joke between friends or for horror themes.
Good versus evil, or someone who looks sweet but is not.

confusedWith.difference: 😈 grins and signals playful mischief or flirtation. 👿 frowns and signals anger, spite or a grudge. Swapping them changes a message from cheeky to hostile.
😡 is a red human face showing hot, open fury. 👿 is purple and horned, suggesting colder, scheming ill will, and is more often used humorously.
👺 is a red Japanese tengu mask with a long nose, linked to folklore and sometimes used for arrogance or trolling. 👿 is a Western cartoon devil expressing a bad mood.

avoid: Do not use it when you mean to flirt; the scowl reads as hostility, and 😈 is the expected choice.
Avoid directing it at someone who may take the implied threat seriously.
Be considerate in religious settings, where devil imagery is not always a joke.
design: A purple face with two horns, deeply furrowed brows and a frown. It mirrors the smiling face with horns in color and shape on every major platform, with only the expression changed. Its earlier Unicode name was “imp.” Shade varies from violet to a darker purple depending on the vendor.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 👿 and 😈?
faqs.a: The expression. 😈 is smiling and used for mischief, confidence and flirting. 👿 is frowning and used for anger, grudges and calling something evil. The smiling version is far more common.

faqs.q: What does 👿 mean from a guy or girl?
faqs.a: It usually means they are annoyed and joking about revenge, or simply in a bad mood. It is not typically flirtatious. If it is aimed at you, they are probably teasing, but check the tone of the rest of the message.
In everyday use, no. It is a cartoon imp expressing grumpiness or spite, similar to calling someone a “little devil.” People rarely intend any religious meaning by it.

“Imp” was the character's original Unicode name. An imp is a small mischievous demon in European folklore. The descriptive name “angry face with horns” was adopted later to match its appearance, and some shortcodes still use “imp.”
